format:
  revealjs:

## A single element {auto-animate=true}

Give an element a `data-id`, then repeat it on the next slide.

::: {data-id="box" style="width:140px; height:140px; background:#5E7699; border-radius:14px; margin:80px auto 0;"}
:::

## The same `data-id`, changed {auto-animate=true}

reveal.js tweens position, size, colour, and radius between the two.

::: {data-id="box" style="width:520px; height:260px; background:#FF9E8A; border-radius:48px; margin:80px auto 0;"}
:::
